name: Private Certificate
definition: Specifies the parameters associated with the production of a certificate to identify the profile of a customer.

CertificationIndicator.name: Certification Indicator
CertificationIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the certificate type has been obtained and verified.

CheckingDate.name: Checking Date
CheckingDate.definition: Date at which the certification check has been performed.

CheckingFrequency.name: Checking Frequency
CheckingFrequency.definition: Specifies how frequently the check is performed.

NextRevisionDate.name: Next Revision Date
NextRevisionDate.definition: Specifies the date at which the next certification check will be performed.

Person.name: Person
Person.definition: Profile of a person for which a private certificate is described.
